text: Oh its a syncing problem. going back to the one i started from, its now just a blank skybox then the new one is a blank skybox. i bet me resetting the app fixes that so its a problem when the app is running.  yes and i just confirmed it also
resolution: Confirmed and fixed as an in-process synchronization defect, not map-file corruption. Whole-map revision invalidation now makes A→B→A rebuild the mounted native projection without requiring an app restart, removes stale coordinates/colliders, and rejects late foliage work from the outgoing map. Verified native map/loader tests and ReleaseFast editor build; awaiting the user's live A→B→A and frame-time check.
